response.rationale: The facial angiofibromas, conical teeth, and EM crystalline inclusions in dermal fibroblasts are pathognomonic for tuberous sclerosis complex, with renal transplantation reflecting renal involvement. Other candidates lack the specific EM finding and clinical combination.

rejected.why: No supportive features; CF skin lesions are unrelated to angiofibroma or crystalline inclusions.
Fibrofolliculomas differ from angiofibromas; no conical teeth or EM inclusions; BHD typically shows fibrofolliculomas on neck/trunk.
Focal dermal hypoplasia presents with atrophic linear lesions, fat herniations, and other syndromic signs; angiofibroma and renal transplant are not characteristic.
